risks.risk: The printer may not power on or may have internal electronic faults.
risks.proof: A video showing the printer powering on and successfully printing a test page.

risks.risk: The toner cartridge may be empty or the drum may be worn out.
risks.proof: A photo of the toner cartridge and a printout of the current toner level from the printer's status screen.
risks.if_unproven: as requiring a new toner cartridge

risks.risk: The scanner glass may be scratched or dirty.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the scanner glass with a document or glass slide.

proof_requests: Video of the printer powering on and printing a test page.
Photo of the toner cartridge and the current toner level.
Photo of the warranty card or original packaging.
response.reason: The model is clearly identified from the photo. It can be priced at its worst-case value (non-functional) until proof of operation and components is provided.
